product_overview: A frontend application for viewing operational dashboards, managing sync job visibility, monitoring system activity, and configuring basic settings. It also includes a UI-only sign-in screen and a data mapping page for working with synchronization-related information.
core_goals: View dashboard metrics, charts, recent jobs, and notifications
Browse, filter, paginate, and inspect sync job details
Review monitoring information for ongoing operational activity
Access data mapping and settings pages for configuration-related viewing
Open the sign-in form and submit it safely without requiring backend authentication

features.name: Sign-in UI
features.description: Provides a UI-only sign-in form where users can enter credentials and submit the form without real backend authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Verify the email or username input is visible -> Verify the password input is visible -> Verify the login action is available -> Enter no credentials and submit the form -> See validation or remain on the sign-in page

features.name: Dashboard UI
features.description: Shows operational dashboard content such as metrics, charts, recent jobs, and notifications using mock data.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboards -> Review dashboard metric cards -> Scan the charts and activity trends -> Review recent jobs -> Review notifications

features.name: Sync Jobs UI
features.description: Shows a sync jobs list with filtering, browsing, pagination, and a detail view for individual jobs using mock data.
user_flows: Navigate to /sync-jobs -> Filter jobs -> Browse the job list -> Open job details -> Change pages

features.name: Monitoring Page
features.description: Allows users to view monitoring-related information on the monitoring page.
user_flows: Navigate to /monitoring -> Review the monitoring information presented on the page

features.name: Data Mapping Page
features.description: Allows users to view data mapping information on the data mapping page.
user_flows: Navigate to /data-mapping -> Review the data mapping information presented on the page

features.name: Settings Page
features.description: Allows users to view application settings on the settings page.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review the settings options presented on the page

routes.description: Sync jobs list and details page.

features.name: Sign-in UI
features.description: Users can view a sign-in form with email and password controls. Submission is currently UI-only and simulates work before navigating.
user_interactions: Verify the email or username input is visible.
Verify the password input is visible.
Verify the Login button is visible.
Click Login with an empty form and confirm validation appears or the user remains on the sign-in page.

features.name: Dashboard UI
features.description: Displays dashboard metrics, charts, recent jobs, notifications, and related operational widgets using mock data.
user_interactions: Scan dashboard metric cards and charts.

features.name: Sync Jobs UI
features.description: Displays sync jobs table, filters, pagination, and detail drawer using mock data.

known_limitations.issue: Sign-in is UI-only and does not call a real authentication backend.
known_limitations.impact: Tests must not expect real credential validation or successful backend login.

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard and sync job data are mock or static UI data.
known_limitations.impact: Tests should validate rendering and interactions, not persisted backend state.
